name: Egg and Veggie Muffin Cups
steps: Preheat the oven to 190°C and grease a 12-cup muffin tin well.
Whisk the eggs and milk together with salt and pepper.
Divide the bell pepper, spinach, and onion evenly between the muffin cups.
Pour the egg mixture over the vegetables in each cup, filling about ¾ full.
Bake 18-20 minutes until puffed and set. Cool slightly before removing from the tin.
Store in the fridge and reheat 2 at a time each morning (roughly 2 muffins per serving).
notes: Freezes very well — a great one to double and freeze half for a slower week.
